challenges.title: Technological Sovereignty
challenges.subtitle: as a national task
challenges.thesisText: 5 areas of Association work: from translating Strategy into concrete projects to standard implementation mechanics.

computing.title: Computational Sovereignty and Infrastructure Independence
computing.shortDesc: We create access to computing power and infrastructure so national projects can scale within the country.
computing.fullDesc: Geopolitical instability dictates new rules: access to computing power today determines leadership tomorrow. To avoid technological lag, we initiate the creation of accessible IT infrastructure necessary for scaling AI projects in Belarus. The Association acts as a bridge between government, business, and society, ensuring transparency in innovation implementation.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Sovereignty and Process Maturity
intellectual.shortDesc: We address the deficit of competencies and management practices: methodologies, standards, project discipline for national-scale initiatives.
intellectual.fullDesc: Technologies are just tools, with 100% effectiveness depending on the competencies of those who manage them. Today, the shortage of qualified personnel and lack of established project management processes for national-scale initiatives are becoming the main barriers to development.

product.title: Product Sovereignty and Capitalization of National Expertise
product.shortDesc: We help turn developments into products: pilots with customers, industry testing, preparation for scaling and export.
product.fullDesc: The future of Belarus's digital economy depends on our ability to transform the service model into a product model while keeping intellectual capital in the country. The Association acts as a consolidator of promising developments and startups.

investment.title: Investment Ecosystem and Capital Consolidation
investment.shortDesc: We set up transparent selection and funding mechanisms for priority projects and shared technological infrastructure.
investment.fullDesc: Belarusian innovations need a powerful financial leap to enter international markets. The Association becomes a hub for attracting private and government investments.

multidisciplinary.title: Multidisciplinary Synthesis: Digital Sovereignty Architecture
multidisciplinary.shortDesc: We connect industries and technologies into a single loop: compatibility, security, standards, and cooperation without excessive bureaucracy.
multidisciplinary.fullDesc: Creating a modern economy is impossible without seamless integration of a whole spectrum of domains: from microelectronics, robotics, and energy infrastructure to neural networks, cloud computing, and blockchain.
